approval_source.method: Explicit user response in this task
approval_source.question: May I record your approval of the T03 prototype baseline and mark T03 Complete? This accepts the current character readability and documented visual limitations, plus proposed future targets of 60 FPS, ≤8 ms CPU/GPU p95, ≤1 GiB process memory and ≤256 MiB rendering allocations on the M2 Max. It does not certify those targets as measured or approve unfinished shader features.

decision: Approved T03 prototype baseline, current character readability, observable still/motion bounds, future measurement targets and documented deviations. This accepts the comparison baseline; it does not certify measured budget compliance or unfinished camera/shader/effect/package features.

approved_bounds.bound: At normal ×1 (9m height, 384×216), identify head/hair, torso, arms and two boots as a complete humanoid with a clear ground silhouette. Review native gameplay pixels, not enlarged diagnostic ×2 or the full-resolution PBR image. Fine facial/armor detail is currently limited and requires an explicit accepted deviation or later T05/BW-098 improvement.

Use physically sensible scene proportions: character 1.8m; small items 0.25–0.5m; barrels 0.85–0.9m; canopy 2.8m; house 4.8m; birch 5.2m. Pose precedes measurement; uniform scaling preserves proportions. Bases contact ground/support and the character footprint stays clear. Normal/diagnostic focus heights are both 1.0m; the 9m/4.5m heights match T02 zooms. Reset remains close/day/135°.

The Adventurer silhouette remains separable from paving, the house and foliage in all three lighting states. Boots and building foundations meet the ground; architecture depth stays visible and amber light preserves character part separation.

T04/T09 must show no stationary pixel changes, no repeated crawl/shimmer on rigid edges during slow/diagonal tracking, no one-frame silhouette disappearance or outline-width pumping. One internal-pixel silhouette lines and selective convex highlights are reviewed in T05. No motion pass is claimed in T03.
No filled-surface outlines, stale reflection/depth frames, actor disappearance or unauthorized information in later combined cases; fallback deviations need explicit review.

approved_budgets.approval: Approved by project owner on 2026-10-20 as future measurement targets only; compliance remains unverified.
approved_budgets.hardware: Current pinned Apple M2 Max / macOS 27.0 / Metal; other targets unverified
approved_budgets.settings: 384x216 internal, 960x640 logical window, actual Retina 2x, source probe
approved_budgets.measurement_plan: T10 retains raw CPU/GPU frame percentiles and process RSS separately from engine rendering allocations, at declared settings. Missing/zero GPU timing is unavailable, never a pass. Include warmup and effects on/off samples; no feasibility measurement is claimed here.

approved_deviations: User-selected Project Titan assets replace the Moore RPG fixture. A complete source Adventurer avoids modular-part alignment errors. The house, birch, market furniture and small props form a courtyard rather than an asset lineup.

The existing flat receiver uses unchanged Titan cobblestone maps at a reversible 4m repeat instead of 2m, making broad paving shapes easier to read. No source texture, source geometry, asset scale or layout changed.

Source graphs and virtual-texture readbacks produced black or white exports. Unsaved PBR materials and unsaved conventional texture duplicates transfer the original authored maps per slot, while preserving original material samplers. Export limitations remain explicit.

Normal ×1 returns to the established T02 9m height. Diagnostic ×2 is 4.5m; both focus at 1m. Reset deliberately retains the existing close/day/135° state. The review evaluates normal ×1 separately. Key rotation is −45°/−55°, fill 0.15 and ambient 0.25/0.18/0.25 for day/warm/cool; this local lighting differs from the source environment.
No final toon/outline, motion, water, contact-depth, atmosphere or performance/package acceptance is claimed.

Current fine face/armor detail and conventional PBR appearance are accepted for this prototype comparison baseline. T05 and later art-production work still own the intended selective bands, silhouette outlines and detail treatment.

The recorded one-level stationary crate variation is accepted as a disclosed baseline limitation, not a live-frame stability pass. T04/T09 must investigate and verify the approved motion bounds before their own acceptance.

The separate merged market showcase uses 10.5m main, 6.5m vendor and 21m settlement framing with the same T02 angle/resolution/presentation policy. It supplements rather than replaces the normal 9m T03 comparison.

criterion_mapping.T03 AC1: Retained annotated normal-scale concept comparison, day/warm/cool pairs and supplementary decoded observations at 00:03/00:30 remain applicable; review.html and readability-reviewed-run identify settings and source hashes.
criterion_mapping.T03 AC2: Explicit project-owner approval records reviewer/date, observable bounds, proposed future targets and permitted deviations. Baseline blocking findings are resolved by acceptance, without claiming later feature verification.
criterion_mapping.T03 AC3: Retained source/asset provenance, continuous heading and thirteen-check reference recovery remain applicable. The merged market branch also passed a fresh eleven-check reference regression and ten/twenty-one-check T01/T02 regressions.
criterion_mapping.epic AC7: The concept-based comparison baseline and approved deviations now pass. Other epic criteria remain independently unfinished.

market_verification.basis: Local deterministic hash checks only; no artwork submitted to an AI model. Automated run records retain their original unreviewed-at-execution status; this later human approval is recorded separately.

remaining_verification: T04–T10 remain Not Started. No live-motion, toon/outline, composition, final water/contact-depth or packaged feasibility approval.
CPU/GPU targets are approved requirements for later measurement; missing GPU timing and invalid memory counters remain unavailable.
Other platforms, physical display/OS scaling and exported packages remain unverified.
evidence_reuse: This status-only update changes no runtime source, settings, assets or retained captures. Existing executed comparisons/provenance and prerequisite runs are reused; they are not relabeled as newly executed game tests.
